notes.title: EA Update .8005
notes.notes:
Early Access .8005 



Thank you everyone for being patient during this EA process! Now that most of the big bugs and a ton of smaller ones have been tackled, we will be moving towards more advanced features and content. I wanted to keep you in the loop of what is coming soon. 

Controller support was super janky before so I spent a good bit of effort fixing a few things in this update. Key Rebinding is in! A much requested feature. This update is but a tiny taste of menu optimization and controller fixes. 

MacOS support is also officially in, welcome to Chronomon my Apple people =)

If you'd like to be a part of the feature decision process and join in on the polls, I invite you to join our discord. We stay true to the EA process and want you to be actively involved in how Chronomon shapes up. 

Discord - https://discord.gg/Cd2U3EQdgV



--- Features --- 

Apple MacOS Support,

MonPC sort menu (Element, Farm Task, Gender, Level, Boss, Rare, DexID, Pages),

Key rebinding,

Keyboard support for navigating most menus,

 --- Other Changes --- 

Egg sizes in breeding algorithm changed to include larger sizes more often (focus on evolution),

Mines generator catches issues and will load you back at the start if needed.,

Medium monsters can also enter holes in walls now,

Farming life skill info fixed (removed plowing as possible exp gain action),

Trees and debris outside of farm bounds will now be removed,

Controller - Mon info menu no longer uses right joystick,

 --- Balancing ---

notes.title: Chronomon December Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and I hope you had a great last month! Here is the run down of everything done since then 

Chronomon List

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840349/5a12d2422a3813f5ed56800b9fc988e76b7782be.png

I spent the last 3 weeks since we spoke putting together the entire Chronomon list and man was it extensive. Here are some fun facts about our monsters!

There are a total of 117 Chronomon for release.
Over 4500 animation frames drawn
Over 200 skills drawn and created
Each monster has from 10-15 skills


ViceVale City (The 2nd city of 7)
I have a large portion of the main questline finished in ViceVale including the NPC schedules done. Vicevale is the envisionment of a post apocalypse, dystopian town full of grunge and vagrants. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43840349/5514faa0bbab84d6809ce6c75b577adc76ce2fe0.png
Not only will Vicevale have diverse shops but its most prominent feature is the underground Arena. Here you can battle 1v1, 1v2 and 1v3 against the many trainers in the city and around Lumeneal. Think you can become #1? 

This feature plays a minor role in the story but gives plenty of value for gaining EXP and rewards. 

What's Next?
Well our Chronomon are still not finished! There is so much data that goes into making them just right from setting stats, coming up with fun description, when or how to level then balancing it all just right so the game progresses smoothly. 

I'm currently in the process of updating a few menus and will stick my head back into the NPCs, schedules, quests and main story line. There is still so much to do! The planned release is in the middle of May, right when the Monster Taming fest happens on Steam. My goal is this will propel Chronomon like a slingshot into a top hit. 

Anyways, thanks again for being there for me and I hope to bring you a game that provides hopefully years of gameplay! 

Happy Holidays, 
- Dev

notes.title: Demo Update 1.014 - Monster Controls and more
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! A new demo update just pushed through on Mobile(Pending review) and PC (Available) adding one of my most anticipated features, Monster Controls! Let's dive in.

Update 1.014
Monster Controls
From our last updates I mentioned wanting this game to have a deeper connection with your Chronomon, not just battling so now you have the ability to directly control them on the map. 

Control - Move your monster around the map
Swap - between the player and your monsters to solve puzzles
Stay - Tell your monster to stay while you roam away from them
Call - Call your monster back to your position
Skills - Use your skills directly on the map, no battles needed. Cut down trees, surf, etc. 
Monsters have the ability to directly fight on the map by themselves. Now when in control you can't use items or swap to other monsters. This will make for what I believe to be some very interesting scenarios. 

Trainers
Trainers have officially been added to the map! Trainer battles, like others consist of multiple monsters and give you Chrons (Money - btw if this is a bad word due to Chrons disease please let me know) afterwards. All battles including trainers happen directly on the map as well. 

 Wild Monsters
Wild monsters now spawn on the map and have their own personalities. 

Scared - These monsters will run from you. When you get close they shiver in fear... but never fret, feeding them will make them like you.
Aloof - These mons don't care at all. They won't run or attack. 
Angry - These will chase you if you get too close with either the player or monster in control. 
Monsters now spawn on the map naturally randomly. When battling, if you lose they will stay on the map as well and chase you down. The player only unalives when attacked with no healthy Chronomon. 

Other Updates
There is a huge list and full update log on Discord if your interested but i'll sum them up here really quick. We have a massive improvement in overall systems fixing various (or many) bugs. A huge amount of QOL changes have been added as well. Many new monsters have been added along with some new quests. One of which opening up a sewer and a boss! Beware however. The sewer is a dangerous slime filled labrinth. hint Bring a fire or electric monster with you, they glow in the dark =)

Other News and Development
As we close the chapter on this last update it's time to move forward on building out the actual game. Don't worry though, soooo many new features will be coming. We haven't touched the tip of it =)

Our map has been built out and will have over 200 massive maps on it. Twice the size of early gen Pokemon games. 

Please let me know your thoughts and again thank you for being with me here on this journey!

- Dev

- npc friendship shown next to face
- You can give items to NPCs now 
- They can Hate, Dislike, Meh, Like and Love the items 
- Each one with their own dialogs. Increase/Decrease Friendship
- You can now click passports in the player menu.
- This opens the towns menu for that passport
- View all INPC (Birthday, gifts given, friendship)
- View town info (Popularity, Quest Board, lore)
- Mobile/PC now have free roam movement
- When clicking items outside shop/inventory, a pop up will appear with its info.
- Entering towns first time shows welcome pop up
- Adding gold will show a pop up
- Can talk to town healer from desk
- Switch between monsters in monster info menu
- ChronoDex! View monster stats/info and show any caught/seen
- Rotate screen in settings
- Scan tool added - Use scan in battles to learn more about monsters.

--- Visual ---

- Leveling up now shows stats increase
- Leveling up VFX on monsters
- (Mobile/PC) Dialog border moved over past hotbar
